title: No new entry in the direction of QQQ's last-60-min move (late-chase veto), all accounts; variant B: longs within 0.15% of QQQ's session high / shorts within 0.15% of its low
hypothesis: On a two-way index day the book enters late in the direction the index has just moved and is caught by the turn. 2026-10-19: QQQ -0.42% at 10:04, +0.69% at 11:37 (high), -0.18% at the close. Across Primary, Testing 1 (incl. 132 replayed trades missing from its journal, estimate) and Testing 2, entries on the same side as QQQ's last-60-min move: 169 trades, 40% wins, -0.285R, -$660.78 after costs; all other entries: 635, 57%, -0.055R, +$113.23. Concentrated in longs entered 11:00-13:59 after the rally (T1 longs with the move 22 trades -0.604R -$233.57 at |move| >= 0.3%; T2 longs 30, -0.371R, -$114.73). Variant B (near the index extreme): T2 longs within 0.15% of QQQ HOD 132 trades -0.283R vs 149 others -0.032R, but T1 longs show no difference and Primary shorts near the low did better (+0.019R vs -0.254R).
notes: History test research/bdi/bdi1019 (PLAN.md pre-declared; 23 configs, bar 2.50; 45 Primary/Testing-1 setups, 366,240 history entries, train <= 2025-12 n 171,078 / 234 days parent -0.065R, valid 2026-01..10-07 n 195,162 / 192 days parent -0.026R; costs in; skipped trade = 0 R; locked block not read; no holdout scored). 0 of 23 pass. Chase veto (QQQ/SPY x 30/60 min x 0/0.2/0.4%), near-extreme variant (0.10/0.15/0.25%) and late chase after 11:00. Best: D-chase-QQQ-60m-0.2-after1100: skips 9%; train delta +0.0062R/trade (t 2.99), valid +0.0047 (t 2.25), valid excess vs random skip +0.0023 (t 1.13), valid up/flat/down +0.0138/+0.0063/-0.0053; also A-chase-SPY-60m-0.2: skips 12%; train delta +0.0055R/trade (t 1.64), valid +0.0044 (t 1.98), valid excess vs random skip +0.0017 (t 0.76), valid up/flat/down +0.0172/+0.0031/-0.0057. The improvement is mostly less exposure to a negative book: vetoed trades are no worse than a random skip of the same share (excess t <= 1.14 in every config), and the veto helps in up sessions and hurts in down sessions (regime bet). No per-setup row passes the per-setup bar 3.73 (23 x 45). Rework ideas (rule 18): long-only setups / side-specific veto; regime-conditional version. Educational only - not financial advice.

title: After the account's intraday peak, block new entries against SPY/QQQ's move since the open (after 10:30)
